snippet.title: OpenFront – Official Early Access Trailer | Steam 17 Sept
snippet.description:
OpenFront is a free browser-based multiplayer strategy game where hundreds of real players and AI opponents fight for one shared map. Forge alliances, build an economy, launch nukes, and betray whoever you have to. OpenFront hits Steam Early Access on 17 September 2026.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3560670/OpenFront/
▶ Play free in your browser: https://openfront.io
▶ Join the Discord: https://discord.com/invite/openfront
▶ Reddit: https://reddit.com/r/Openfront/

What's in the game:
• Hundreds of real players in a single match — no lobbies, no waiting
• Hundreds of AI opponents to fight or ally with
• 100+ maps, from real-world regions to fantasy continents
• Alliances, betrayals, trade, and full-scale nuclear war
• Cross-play between Steam and browser
• Free forever at openfront.io

Trailer by Lonely — huge thanks for the help putting it together.

#OpenFront #StrategyGames #IndieGame #Multiplayer #EarlyAccess
